_que_es: Unidades de la receta Fishing (peces), 2026-11-02. Referencia de estilo: la hoja de mascotas.

ia.prompt: Nine cute chunky baby creatures with big shiny eyes and happy faces, each standing on tiny stubby feet, in this order: 1) sardine: a small shiny silver sardine, 2) clownfish: an orange clownfish with white stripes, 3) pufferfish: a round yellow pufferfish with soft spikes, 4) salmon: a pink and orange salmon, 5) swordfish: a blue swordfish with a long pointy nose, 6) octopus: a purple baby octopus with curly tentacles, 7) shark: a friendly gray-blue baby shark, 8) golden_koi: a shiny golden koi fish with flowing fins, 9) baby_kraken: a dark teal baby kraken with glowing cyan eyes and curly tentacles.
